title: Remodeled Stylish 1BR - Walk Downtown Nashville
description:
**Self Check-In & Sanitized!**

Easily attend any downtown event or conference, and enjoy everything downtown has to offer!  Walk to the most popular spots, including Broadway Honky Tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, Ascend Amphitheater, The historic Ryman Theater, or take a short ride to local neighborhoods such as The Gulch, Music Row, Midtown, West End, Germantown, Edge Hill, 12th South, and East Nash.  The options are endless and you are at the center of it all!

The space
This one bedroom condo has all of the updates along with a VERY comfy  KING bed and a stylish QUEEN sleeper couch.  Can sleep up to four very comfortably.  The space is perfectly laid out with a full kitchen, full dining area, bar stools and bar space, main living space and full bathroom with oversized shower and multiple large closets.  All essential items provided from soaps and shampoos, to ironing boards, coffee makers, and utensils.  We dare you to not to feel at home in this space!  And FREE gated parking!

Guest access
Guests have full access to the condo and all amenities, such as free laundry in the unit itself and also more on site, picnic area with grill, and pet restroom area.  The complex is fully secure and completely gated!  Free parking inside or outside of the gate!

Other things to note
This property is permitted for short term rental by the metropolitan government of Nashville (permit #2021017901)
